cards.name: Heatran
cards.description: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.

cards.name: Chimchar
cards.description: It agilely scales sheer cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.

cards.name: Croagunk
cards.description: Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.

cards.name: Happiny
cards.description: It loves round white things. It carries an egg-shaped rock in imitation of CHANSEY.

cards.name: Piplup
cards.description: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.description: Its body is lithe yet powerful. It can crest three mountains and cross two canyons in one night.

cards.name: Turtwig
cards.description: Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.description: By catching the aura emanating from others, it can read their thoughts and movements.

cards.name: Luxray
cards.description: When its eyes gleam gold, it can spot hiding prey–even those taking shelter behind a wall.

cards.name: Probopass
cards.description: It exudes strong magnetium from all cover. It controls three small units called Mini-Noses.

cards.name: Yanmega
cards.description: By churning its wings, it creates shock waves that inflict critical internal injuries to foes.

cards.name: Cherrim
cards.description: It blooms during times of strong sunlight. It tries to make up for everything it endured as a bud.

cards.name: Carnivine
cards.description: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.

cards.name: Luxio
cards.description: Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.
